summary: Independently verified Razorpay payment integration. Backend: 7/7 pytest passing — create-order (valid returns order_id/amount=29000/currency=INR/key_id=rzp_live_*, Mongo persistence status='created'; invalid email -> 422), verify (valid HMAC-SHA256 signature -> 200 {status:'paid', download_url:'/business-management-toolkit.xlsx'} + Mongo doc status='paid' with payment_id; invalid signature -> 400 'Payment verification failed' + Mongo doc status='signature_failed'), regression GET /api/ and /api/status intact, /business-management-toolkit.xlsx serves 200. Frontend: hero-cta-buy, pricing-cta-buy, sticky-buy-button (appears on scroll/mobile) all present; clicking opens buy-modal; entering valid email + clicking buy-submit successfully launches Razorpay Checkout iframe (api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public) with email prefilled and ₹290 shown; no LIVE payment attempted. No blocking console errors from our app.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined AFTER it is referenced inside `create_order` (line 96 uses logger; logger defined at line 158). Works only because usage is inside a function and logging.basicConfig set the root logger, but if Razorpay call fails at module import time or before file executes past line 158, NameError could occur. Move logger init to top of file.
server.py: no idempotency/duplicate protection on verify — replaying a valid HMAC would keep updating the doc. For LIVE keys consider guarding with `status != 'paid'` check.
No rate limiting on /payments/create-order — could spam live Razorpay order creation.
seed_data_creation: Test orders created in Mongo db.orders via create-order calls (3 orders with test emails buyer@shop.com / buyer2@shop.com / buyer3@shop.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend payments tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py. It computes HMAC using RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET from backend/.env and hits public URL. Do NOT attempt real UI checkout — LIVE keys.
